name: Emanation (Love)
scaffolding_intent: Emits heart particles around an entity and shifts its tint toward pink, showing affection or tenderness

parameters.name: tint
parameters.description: RGB tint shift applied to entity pixels (additive)

parameters.name: tintSaturation
parameters.description: How strongly the tint is applied (0 = no tint, 1 = full tint)

correction_intent: Child attributed a wrong emotion to a character the scene shows loving or tender (hugging, cuddling a pet, gazing fondly, holding hands, gentle smile). Target that character, or the pair if the affection is mutual. Not for plain happiness or excitement without a loved object; that is another Emanation variant.
suggestion_intent: A character visibly shows affection or tenderness toward someone or something (hugging, cuddling, gazing fondly, holding hands) and the child has not said so. Target that character, or the pair. Requires a visible cue of affection.
